# sherpa-calendar

A date picker with day / month / year views. The header label zooms OUT (day → month → year); picking one zooms back IN.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | Calendar |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-calendar/sherpa-calendar.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-calendar/sherpa-calendar.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-calendar/sherpa-calendar.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-calendar/sherpa-calendar.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-calendar/sherpa-calendar.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-calendar value="2026-08-13"></sherpa-calendar>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-available` | text |  | comma-separated ISO days that EXIST in the data; every other day is disabled. A SET, not a span — a column of dates is a scatter, and min/max would leave the empty days between them selectable. Omit it and every day is selectable, which is the override: a host that wants a picker unconstrained by its own data simply does not supply one. |
| `data-embedded` | boolean | `false` | the HOST owns the card's chrome — see the note below data-embedded: this component contributes only its GRID — the footer is hidden and the stepper is projected into the host's `header` slot, so a menu hosting a calendar has ONE header and ONE footer rather than two. |
| `data-has-time` | boolean | `false` | show a native &lt;input type=time> in the footer |
| `data-type` | `single` `range` | `single` | single \| range — one day, or a two-click start→end range |
| `data-value-end` | text |  | range end, ISO YYYY-MM-DD (range mode) |
| `data-value-start` | text |  | range start, ISO YYYY-MM-DD (range mode) |
| `data-view` | `day` `month` `year` | `day` | day \| month \| year — the active picker (the Grid-collection swap) |
| `max` | text, native |  | latest selectable day (ISO); later days are disabled |
| `min` | text, native |  | earliest selectable day (ISO); earlier days are disabled |
| `value` | text, native |  | selected day, ISO YYYY-MM-DD (single mode); YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm when data-has-time is set |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `checkValidity()` | Is it acceptable, as its form sees it? |
| `reportValidity()` | Check, and show the browser's message on the control. |
| `formDisabledCallback()` | Inside a disabled `<fieldset>`: nothing to pick. |
| `formResetCallback()` | A form reset puts back its first value. |
| `today()` | Jump to today and select it. — an embedded calendar's Today button lives in the HOST's footer, so it needs a public door. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `datetime-change` | `{ value: string }` |
| `range-select` | `{ end: string; start: string }` |
| `calendar-cancel` |  |
| `calendar-apply` | `{ value: string }` |
